quotes.text: The merchant delinquency risk signal identifies connected accounts at risk of carrying a negative balance for more than 90 days.
Enter your email to request access.
On Radar Plus and Radar Pro, the signal also includes a `probability` score with a value between 0 and 100.
Listen for `v2.signals.account_signal.merchant_delinquency_ready` event notifications when a delinquency signal is evaluated.

answers.Q1: The November 7 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/radar/merchant-delinquency-risk describes Stripe evaluating connected-account delinquency risk, specifically risk of a negative balance lasting more than 90 days. The platform can request early access and retrieve the latest risk level and indicators from the linked Signals reference. The result lists highest, elevated, normal and low; Plus and Pro also get a probability score. Stripe notifies the platform with v2.signals.account_signal.merchant_delinquency_ready, after which the platform can choose a Radar action (new raw lines 7-36 and 60-66). The May guide and source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md described broader distress, five levels including not_assessed, 16 indicators and a v1 event (old raw lines 6-24 and 30-55).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/radar/merchant-delinquency-risk, substantive November changes are the over-90-day prediction horizon, early access route, version-linked Signals retrieval reference, v2 notification, tiered probability and reduced result vocabulary and indicator table (new raw lines 7-36 and 38-62). Preserve May's historical v1 event, not_assessed and duplicates rows, and financial-distress wording (old raw lines 6-24 and 30-55). Their omission does not establish API-wide removal. Treat table styling and downstream Radar action links as presentation/navigation (old raw lines 53-55; new raw lines 64-66). Keep the reciprocal Radar concept route and the separate fraudulent-merchant and website contracts in source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md. The other signals' event payload shape and tiers do not establish this signal's.
